items.title: John Heard interviewed by Monk Rowe and Michael Woods, Scottsdale, Arizona, March 4, 1995
items.q: Red Holloway — he lies all the time.

ctx.x: And welcome. On our way over to the interview we had a comment from Red Holloway about how he thinks that you held that whole first session together over there today and being that the bass is such as important instrument, we wonder how you came to the bass and what attracted you to that instrument?
Okay. I’ll answer your first thing. Red Holloway — he lies all the time.
